title: Remove Broken Repo Search MCP Tool
description: The repo mcp tool `search` hangs infinitely and must be removed from the repo MCP server implementation.
summary: Removed the `search` MCP tool from the repo MCP server (Go implementation) because its handler could hang indefinitely — BuildMonorepoTreeCached's lock-acquisition loop retries forever with no context-aware timeout. Deleted the tool registration, its per-client description map entry, and the now-unreferenced mcpTree handler. Verified `go build ./...` still passes and no other references to the tool remain.
